cfpb-heloc.title: What is a home equity line of credit (HELOC)? (Consumer Financial Protection Bureau)
cfpb-heloc.supports: HELOC is an open-end line of credit; draw period then repayment period; usually variable rate; you could lose your home if you cannot repay; lender may freeze additional borrowing.

cfpb-heloc-vs-loan.title: What is the difference between a home equity loan and a HELOC? (Consumer Financial Protection Bureau)
cfpb-heloc-vs-loan.supports: Home equity loan pays a lump sum; HELOC can be drawn several times; HELOCs usually have adjustable rates; both are second mortgages paid in addition to the first mortgage.

cfpb-reverse.title: What is a reverse mortgage? (Consumer Financial Protection Bureau)
cfpb-reverse.supports: HECM is a home loan only for homeowners 62 and older; borrowers do not make monthly mortgage payments but owe more over time; homeowners must pay property taxes and homeowners insurance and keep the house in good condition; loan is due when the borrower no longer lives in the home.

cfpb-loan-estimate.title: Loan estimate explainer (Consumer Financial Protection Bureau)
cfpb-loan-estimate.supports: A Loan Estimate lists loan details; request several Loan Estimates to compare lenders; origination charges are lender fees; some services are required and chosen by the lender, others you can shop for.

fnma-adu.title: Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs) (Fannie Mae)
fnma-adu.supports: Definition of an ADU; ADUs can be within, attached to or detached from the home; no specific type of financing is required for a home with an ADU; HomeStyle Renovation can finance adding an ADU when purchasing or refinancing a 1-unit property; construction-to-permanent for a new home with an ADU; ADUs not eligible with a 2-4 unit dwelling or a manufactured home as primary residence; multiple ADUs ineligible.

fnma-b3-3-8-02.title: B3-3.8-02, Rental Income from the Subject Property (Fannie Mae Selling Guide)
fnma-b3-3-8-02.supports: Rental income from one existing ADU allowed with a one-unit primary residence; purchase or limited cash-out refinance only; ADU income limited to 30% of total qualifying income; lenders must support rent with Form 1007 or 1025.

pasadena-adu.title: Accessory Dwelling Units (City of Pasadena Planning & Community Development)
pasadena-adu.pageDate: no update date shown on page
pasadena-adu.supports: Ordinance No. 7420 effective May 20, 2024; online applications through the CSS Permit Portal; virtual consultation for preliminary zoning feedback; ADU Standard Plans Program with no modifications; fee reductions for smaller ADUs or when using a standard plan or Housing Agreement; optional Housing Agreements restrict how the unit is used or rented; JADU size cap and location; an ADU will increase property taxes, set by LA County.

lthm-heloc.title: HELOC and Home Equity Loans (Let's Talk Home Mortgage)
lthm-heloc.supports: Pat's own explanation: HELOC vs home equity loan, second position, draw and repayment periods, closing cost categories, appraisal or automated valuation.

lthm-refinance.title: Refinance (Let's Talk Home Mortgage)
lthm-refinance.supports: Pat's own explanation: cash-out refinance replaces the existing mortgage with a new larger loan; considerations; if you already have a low first-mortgage rate a refinance may not be ideal and a HELOC or home equity loan are alternatives.

lthm-reverse.title: Reverse Mortgage (Let's Talk Home Mortgage)
lthm-reverse.supports: Pat's own explanation: HECM for 62+, obligations, counseling, eligible property types, cost categories, repayment events, existing mortgage paid off first.

lthm-nonqm.title: Non-QM Mortgage (Let's Talk Home Mortgage)
lthm-nonqm.supports: DSCR rental-income loans are described for investment properties.
